name: Prestige Estates Projects Ltd.
business_summary: Bengaluru-based diversified developer: residential (Bengaluru, Mumbai, NCR, Hyderabad, Chennai, Kochi), offices, retail and hospitality, with the highest leverage among listed peers (interest Rs 1,617 cr TTM, 45% of operating profit). Q2 FY27 bookings Rs 7,225 cr (+20%), Rs 40,000 cr launches planned in H2 FY27 (Business Standard 2026-10-20). Recent: CPP Investments to buy 27% of the hospitality arm for Rs 3,000 cr (2026-09-30) after hospitality IPO plans were dropped (2026-09-28); Gloind Vintage Infra acquisition at Rs 519 cr EV (2026-11-04); Bombay HC set aside a MahaREAT order in Mahalaxmi (2026-10-01). Market cap Rs 70,123 cr, P/E 61.6.

exposures.mechanism: Residential ~65% of value (Bengaluru ~50% of bookings, also Mumbai, NCR, Hyderabad, Chennai; model estimate), rest office/retail/hospitality. +10% market volume -> bookings +10% (Rs 7,225 cr/qtr base) -> EBITDA +11% -> x0.65 = +7% x EV/MCap 1.25 x persistence 0.55 ~ +5. Anarock +3% y/y Jul-Sep 2026.

evidence.note: Anarock via Economic Times 2026-09-28: Jul-Sep 2026 housing sales +3% y/y to just over 1 lakh units across top 7 cities
